__desc: How japandi.dev, the personal website of the developer behind Japandi Dev, handles information about the people who visit it.
__ogalt: The Japandi Dev logo beside the words Japandi Dev and the line Coding with simplicity and purpose.
this_policy_explains_how:
This policy explains how Japandi Dev handles information when you visit
        japandi.dev or contact Japandi Dev by email.
japandi_dev_is_a:
Japandi Dev is a static website. It has no user accounts, contact forms,
        advertising, or third-party embeds. It uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand
        site usage and real-world performance without creating individual visitor profiles.
cloudflare_web_analytics_processes:
Cloudflare Web Analytics processes aggregate metrics such as visits, page views,
        referring sites, approximate country, device type, browser, operating system, page-load
        timing, and Core Web Vitals including LCP, INP, and CLS. Cloudflare states that this
        service does not use cookies or track individual visitors across websites.
the_site_is_delivered:
The site is delivered through Cloudflare and hosted by Biznet Gio. To deliver
        and protect the site, these providers may process standard technical request data,
        including your IP address, request date and time, requested page, referrer, browser
        or device information, and security-related events. Japandi Dev uses this processing
        only to operate, secure, and troubleshoot the website.
cloudflare_web_analytics_is:
Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookie-free and does not store analytics identifiers in
        your browser. Cloudflare may set a strictly necessary cookie if one of its security
        features is triggered. Japandi Dev does not use cookies for advertising or cross-site tracking.
email_links_on_this:
Email links on this site open your own email application. If you contact Japandi
        Dev, the information you choose to include—such as your email address, name, and message—is
        used to respond to you, manage the conversation, and address any related security or legal
        issue. Please do not send sensitive personal information that is not needed for your request.
japandi_dev_does_not: Japandi Dev does not sell personal information. Information is shared only as needed with:
which_delivers_and_protects: , which delivers and protects the site;
the_email_service_providers: the email service providers involved when you choose to send an email; and
authorities_or_other_parties: authorities or other parties when reasonably necessary to comply with law, protect rights and safety, or investigate abuse.
cloudflare_operates_a_global:
Cloudflare operates a global network, so technical request data may be processed outside
        your country. Each service provider handles information under its own privacy terms.
analytics_and_technical_request:
Analytics and technical request data are processed and retained by Cloudflare and
        Biznet Gio according to their service settings and policies. Japandi Dev does not export
        or maintain a separate visitor-level analytics database.
        Email correspondence is kept only for as long as it is reasonably needed for the conversation,
        security, record-keeping, or legal obligations, and is then deleted when no longer needed.
you_may_ask_whether:
You may ask whether Japandi Dev holds personal information from an email conversation,
        and request access, correction, or deletion. A request may be limited where retaining
        information is necessary for security, record-keeping, or a legal obligation. You can also
        contact Cloudflare or Biznet Gio directly about information they process under their policies.
this_policy_covers_japandi:
This policy covers japandi.dev only. Applications published by Japandi Dev, including
        Squirio, have separate privacy policies describing their own data practices.
if_this_policy_changes:
If this policy changes, the updated policy and its new revision date will be published
        on this page.
for_privacy_questions_or: For privacy questions or requests, email
return_to_the_japandi: Return to the Japandi Dev home page
a_personal_space_for: A personal space for coding, thoughtful products, and Japandi-inspired ideas.
